entries.995e5c42a4c771b9: The company manufactures in-house a wide range of wood materials, from plywood to fiberboards such as MDF and hardboard and interior materials, and has group production bases such as the Shimizu Works and Fujikawa Works and Ishinomaki Plywood Manufacturing. A strength is its structure for handling everything from material manufacturing to construction within the group, through sales with installation by its subsidiary Nafix (materials and construction sales) and design and construction of exterior structures by Arimoto Kogyo. It also offers proprietary products and methods such as the interior materials series "Kanaeru," the structural surface material "HBW," and the wood sound insulation and fireproof method "Shaon."
